description: This PHP source file defines the class OA_Upgrade_Login, which manages login and auto-login functionalities during software installation or upgrade for the Revive Adserver project.

classes.name: OA_Upgrade_Login
classes.description: A class to handle login and auto-login processes during installation and upgrade of the Revive Adserver.

methods.name: checkLogin
methods.description: Checks administrator login during upgrade steps, verifying session and credentials.

methods.name: autoLogin
methods.description: Performs automatic login if external authentication is used and conditions are met.

methods.name: _checkLoginNew
methods.description: Handles login verification for new user authentication methods, supporting MD5 password hashes.

methods.name: _checkLoginOld
methods.description: Handles login verification for older authentication methods, supporting cookie and database checks.

methods.name: readSession
methods.description: Fetches session data, adjusting for PostgreSQL timezone issues if necessary.
